3D.11 Comments on how other rate used in calculating dividend/distribution rate is set
This represents the value of "minus ((Dividend/distribution base rate + Dividend/distribution margin) x Tax Rate of 30%)"
3D.12 Total dividend/distribution rate for the period (pa)
5.3718 %
3D.13 Comment on how total distribution rate is set
Total dividend/distribution rate = (Dividend/distribution base rate + Dividend/distribution margin) x (1 - Tax Rate of 30%)
Part 5 - Further information
5.1 Please provide any further information applicable to this dividend/distribution
The distribution in this form is the scheduled cash distribution and is expected to be fully franked.  
Note that under the PERLS XII terms and conditions, the Commonwealth Bank of Australia has the discretion to make or
not make the distribution in full.  
Distributions will be paid by electronic transfer.
